label: batch-12
tail:
Batch 12 is authored: 15 A-page items, 5 B-page examples, both draft pages, the updated manifest and coverage, cross-batch record, proof contracts, authoring notes, and 20 Step 1 readiness records.

The A page includes the causal spline definition and a complete Ewald force derivative proof. The PME evaluator uses FFT gathers and a cyclic kernel for self correction. The batch has no current cross-batch edges; its item levels run from 0 to 6.

Scoped checks passed: precheck 16/16, rendercheck 20/20, proof-layout 20 items and 73 steps with 0 defects, strict contracts 20/20, and content policy, coverage checklist, and focused depcheck with 0 errors. Source fetch verified 5/6 occurrences; all 6 are resolved, including one documented retired URL.

**Run-wide blocker:** the whole-run dependency and Step 1 commands cannot parse the unrelated batch 49 manifest because of an unescaped `\mathcal` at line 151, column 198. I left that file unchanged. To record the assigned readiness rows, I used the native Step 1 tool on a temporary snapshot with only that escape corrected there, verified 20/20 rows closed against the batch 12 dependency closure, then copied the rows into the assigned research evidence. The whole-run checks still need the owner’s batch 49 repair.

The existing unmanifested force-gradient draft remains untouched for owner reconciliation. No content was published or independently approved.
